q.line: Half formed, fast walking, half fury, half boredom
stanza: Hard rain falling on all the halfhearted
Half formed, fast walking, half fury, half boredom
Hard talking, half dead from exhaustion
Half pushed but the puddles keep forming, don't fall in

partner.line: Hard talking, half dead from exhaustion

q.line: Contempt, contempt and contempt for the boredom
q.lineNext: I shall poison the city and sink it with fire
